transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the disposition huddle for the 1,200 actuator housings currently on hold. We all know the drawing was revised and the housings are physically available, but we haven't approved a final disposition or shipment plan yet. I've got production capacity available this week if we decide on rework. Before I make the call, I need to hear from quality and customer fulfillment on what you're finding. Quality, can you start us off?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My dimensional review, completed this morning with the validated gauge, found that exactly 500 of the 1,200 housings conform to the old drawing and can be released to North Plant. The remaining exactly 700 housings can be reworked to the revised drawing, but each reworked housing requires exactly 10 hours of machining and 100% dimensional inspection before release. The review is still in the engineering hold folder pending this disposition huddle.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have written acceptance from North Plant that exactly 500 housings made to the old drawing may ship by Wednesday at 16:00, and South Plant's order requires exactly 700 housings made to the revised drawing by Friday at 12:00. I haven't entered the acceptance in the order system yet because the held-material disposition is still awaiting Marisol's approval.
